steps.tip: Sten stands just outside Anvilmar. The Ragged Young Wolves are all around the starting area, so you finish this on the walk.

steps.speed: Hit every Rockjaw Trogg you pass as well; they count for A New Threat in a minute.

steps.text: Turn in Dwarven Outfitters to Sten Stoutarm, then accept Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery from him and A New Threat from Balir Frosthammer beside him

steps.tip: Shaman is new for Dwarves in Forever. Your trainer Teo Hammerstorm is inside Anvilmar with the others.
Priest is new for Gnomes in Forever; you train with Branstock Khalder like Dwarf priests.

steps.text: Optional: pick up a gathering profession from the junior trainers by the Anvilmar door (mining, herbalism or skinning)
steps.prof: Forever adds junior gathering trainers to the starting areas, so you can start mining, herbalism or skinning at level 1 instead of waiting for Kharanos or Ironforge.

steps.tip: Plain troggs are around the valley floor; the Burly ones sit further west toward the frozen pond.

steps.text: Turn in the mail to Talin Keeneye at his camp in the west, then accept the next delivery and The Boar Hunter

steps.tip: Small Crag Boars roam the slope right behind Talin's camp.

steps.text: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard at the camp south of Talin and accept The Troll Cave

steps.tip: The mug of Mornbrew goes cold after five minutes. Run straight up to Anvilmar and do not stop to fight.

steps.text: Turn in Scalding Mornbrew Delivery to Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar and take back the empty mug

steps.tip: Warlocks: the Feather Charms drop from the Frostmane Novices at the troll camp, next to Grik'nir.
Shamans: the bear pendants drop from the same trolls you kill for The Troll Cave.

steps.text: Train your new level 2-4 spells

steps.tip: Kill the Troll Whelps around the camp before you go into the cave.

steps.text: Grab Felix's Box beside the frozen lake west of the troll camp
Grab Felix's Chest at the southern edge of the troll camp
Grab Felix's Bucket of Bolts east of the troll camp
Turn in The Troll Cave to Grelin Whitebeard and accept The Stolen Journal

steps.tip: Grik'nir the Cold waits at the back of the cave. Clear the Novices on the way in; they come in pairs.

steps.text: Turn in The Stolen Journal to Grelin and accept Senir's Observations
Turn in Call of Earth to Teo Hammerstorm and accept the next part

steps.tip: Priests: this sends you to Maxan Anvol in Kharanos for your first robe quest.
New in Forever. Grund stands inside Anvilmar; his partner's camp is up the hill to the northwest.
The Snow Leopard Prowler is a single tougher cat at the camp. Pull it away from the tents before you loot the log.

steps.text: Drink the Earth Sapta at the Spirit Stone northwest of Anvilmar, talk to the Minor Manifestation of Earth and accept the last Call of Earth

steps.tip: Teo gives you your Earth Totem. Train before you leave the valley.

steps.text: Visit your class trainer before leaving Coldridge
Turn in Senir's Observations to Mountaineer Thalos at the tunnel and accept the follow-up plus The Adventurer
steps.tip: The Adventurer is a Forever camping quest. It sends you to Eric Brighthammer outside the Kharanos inn.

steps.speed: Run through the tunnel to Kharanos now. Nothing else in the valley is worth going back for.

steps.text: Turn in Senir's Observations to Senir Whitebeard outside the Kharanos inn, then accept Secure the Mountain
Hand the Supply Bundle to Eric Brighthammer by the campfire next to Senir and accept The Great Outdoors

steps.tip: Sit right at Eric's Basic Campfire until the Boosted Rest buff appears. Forever lets campfires build rested XP while you sit.

steps.text: Turn in The Great Outdoors and accept the Camping 101 quests from Eric
Turn in The Great Outdoors and accept Camping 101: Cooking
Turn in Supplies to Tannok to Tannok Frosthammer inside the inn
Set your hearthstone at Innkeeper Belm in Kharanos
Talk to Gremlock Pilsnor, the cooking trainer in the inn, to finish Camping 101: Cooking
steps.prof: This also teaches the Basic Campfire, so you can make your own rest spot later.

steps.text: Talk to Thamner Pol, the first aid trainer in the inn, to finish Camping 101: First Aid
steps.prof: Learn First Aid from Thamner first; the Camping 101 turn-in expects you to have the skill.

steps.text: Priests: turn in In Favor of the Light to Maxan Anvol inside the inn and accept Garments of the Light

steps.tip: Buy the Rhapsody Malt from Innkeeper Belm when you come back; the ribs drop from any Crag Boar.

steps.text: Walk north to Steelgrill's Depot: turn in Tools for Steelgrill to Beldin Steelgrill and accept Stocking Jetsteam from Pilot Bellowfiz

steps.tip: Mountaineer Dolf is the wounded dwarf on the road just south of Kharanos. Use Lesser Heal rank 2, then Power Word: Fortitude.

steps.text: Kill Crag Boars around Kharanos for 6 Crag Boar Ribs
Turn in Secure the Mountain to Mountaineer Gretchen west of Kharanos and accept the next part
Loot the Ammo Crate next to Mountaineer Gretchen's camp
steps.tip: Blizzard fixed the ammo loot on 9 November, so the crate gives Rumbleshot's Ammo again.
Hegnar Rumbleshot's hut is down the slope south of the road. He also sells ammo for Hunters and gun users.

steps.text: Kill bears for 2 Thick Bear Furs and Crag Boars for 4 Chunks of Boar Meat on the way to the Grizzled Den
steps.tip: Young Black Bears are on the hills west of Kharanos; any Crag Boar drops the meat.
Wendigos fill the Grizzled Den cave and the snowfield outside it. Clear the outside first.
The Flintfire Shipments are small crates on the cave floor; grab them while you kill Wendigos.
Mountaineer Cornelius is deeper inside the Grizzled Den.

steps.text: Return to Mountaineer Gretchen, turn in Secure the Mountain and accept her report
Turn in Secure the Mountain to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos
Buy a Rhapsody Malt from Innkeeper Belm, then turn in Beer Basted Boar Ribs to Ragnar Thunderbrew

steps.tip: This candle crate opens the new Misty Pine Refuge quests east of Kharanos. Keep it until you head east.

steps.text: Train at the Kharanos trainers
Turn in Stocking Jetsteam to Pilot Bellowfiz and accept Evershine

segments.title: Brewnall Village, Gnomeregan and Frostmane Hold

steps.tip: Tundra MacGrann camps on the road west of Kharanos. His meat locker is in Old Icebeard's cave, which you pass on the way back.

steps.text: In Brewnall Village, turn in Evershine to Rejold Barleybrew and accept A Favor for Evershine and The Perfect Stout

steps.tip: New in Forever. Frosthowl is a named wolf near the Grizzled Den, so you get it on the way back east.
Shimmer Ridge is north of the road. Loot the Shimmerweed baskets and kill the Frostmane Seers; both give weed.
Leper Gnomes wander outside the Gnomeregan entrance. Both parts drop from them; Gibblewilt is a named one with better odds.
Frostmane Hold is the troll cave southwest of Brewnall. The Headhunters throw axes, so fight them at the entrance instead of inside.
Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars and Snow Leopards share the open ground between the Grizzled Den and Kharanos.
Old Icebeard's cave is south of the road. You can sneak to the meat locker along the left wall and skip the elite yeti.

steps.text: Go down into the Thunderbrew Distillery basement in Kharanos and swap the barrel: turn in Bitter Rivals and accept Return to Marleth
steps.tip: Jarven guards the barrel. Talk to him first and buy him a Thunder Ale from the innkeeper, or he will not move.
Ingrid Dunwald trains Shamans here in Kharanos. Your fire totem quest sends you east to the South Gate.

steps.text: Train your level 10 spells
steps.tip: Warlocks: the Voidwalker quest starts from Lago Blackwrench in Ironforge and runs through Stormwind. Dwarf priests: Desperate Prayer also ends in Stormwind; pick it up when you go there for Redridge.

steps.text: Get the Ironforge flight path from Gryth Thurden
Turn in The Reports to Senator Barin Redstone in the High Seat
Warriors: turn in Muren Stormpike in the Military Ward and accept Vejrek
Mages: turn in Speak with Bink in the Mystic Ward and accept Mage-tastic Gizmonitor
Rogues: turn in Road to Salvation to Hulfdan Blackbeard and accept Simple Subterfugin'
Priests: turn in Confounding Flash to High Priestess Mims in the Mystic Ward

steps.tip: New in Forever. The data cards are in snowdrifts outside Gnomeregan, which you are heading back to.

steps.text: Turn in Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash on the road west of Kharanos
Turn in Return to Marleth to Marleth Barleybrew in Brewnall
Turn in A Favor for Evershine to Rejold Barleybrew and accept Return to Bellowfiz
Turn in The Perfect Stout and accept Shimmer Stout
steps.tip: Shimmer Stout goes all the way to the South Gate, and the next part ends in Thelsamar. Keep it for the trip to Loch Modan.
Bink's Toolbox lies outside the Gnomeregan entrance among the Leper Gnomes.

steps.text: Rogues: find Onin MacHammar near Gnomeregan, turn in Simple Subterfugin' and accept Onin's Report

steps.tip: Vejrek is a level 11 troll south of Frostmane Hold. Pull him alone.

steps.speed: Hearth back to Kharanos instead of walking.

steps.tip: Use the Taming Rod on a Large Crag Boar from range, then just let the channel finish.

steps.text: Turn in the last Taming the Beast and accept Training the Beast
steps.tip: Tame the pet you want to keep next. A boar or bear tanks best early on.

steps.text: Turn in the last Taming the Beast, then tame the pet you want to keep
Turn in Return to Bellowfiz to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot
Bring the candles to Father Gavin at Misty Pine Refuge and accept Finding Warmth
steps.tip: Misty Pine Refuge is new in Forever, on the hill east of the Ironforge road.
Fallen logs lie in the pine woods south of the refuge.

steps.text: Turn in Finding Warmth and accept Rime's Wrath and Treacherous Cold
Turn in Finding Warmth and accept Rime's Wrath

steps.tip: Minor Ice Elementals drift all over the slope north of the refuge.

steps.text: Pick up Coalbeard's Rifle in the snow west of the elementals

steps.tip: Avala is a bigger ice elemental at the top of the slope. Clear the small ones nearby first.

steps.text: Pick up Sunhammer's Rifle in the snow east of the refuge
Pick up Stoneanvil's Rifle in the snow to the south, then go back to Father Gavin
Warriors: in Ironforge, bring Vejrek's head to Muren Stormpike and accept Tormus Deepforge
Warriors: turn in Tormus Deepforge in the Great Forge and accept Ironband's Compound
Hunters: turn in Training the Beast to Belia Thundergranite in the Hall of Arms

segments.title: Amberstill Ranch, Gol'Bolar Quarry and the gates

steps.tip: New in Forever. The Elder Snow Leopards are east of the quarry, so you collect pelts while doing the trogg quests.
Vagash is a level 11 wolf in the hills just north of the ranch. Eat and drink first.
Skullthumpers are on the quarry floor and around the mine entrance.
If an Empty Powder Keg drops from a trogg, it starts a Forever quest at the quarry.

steps.text: Bring the Empty Powder Keg to Quarrymaster Thesten and accept the follow-up

steps.tip: Bonesnappers patrol east of the quarry. Pull them one at a time; they hit hard for their level.
Ironband's Strongbox is inside the compound by the lake. Dark Iron Spies wander here; they also drop the map for the Hall of Thanes later.

steps.text: Turn in Never Saddle on Quality to Rudra Amberstill at the ranch

steps.tip: Pilot Hammerfoot is at the North Gate Pass, up the road northeast of the quarry.

steps.text: Find the dwarven corpse west of the North Gate, turn in The Lost Pilot and accept A Pilot's Revenge

steps.tip: Mangeclaw roams near the corpse. He is a level 11 leopard; fight him with full health.

steps.text: Go to the South Gate Outpost, turn in Shimmer Stout to Mountaineer Barleybrew and accept Stout to Kadrell
Shamans: turn in Call of Fire to Bruegs Kindleborn north of the gate and accept the next part
steps.tip: The bug report about With Wind Beneath Your Wings (79365) does not affect you here: that quest is not in our data, so this route skips it.

steps.text: Grind Rockjaw Backbreakers east of the quarry until level 12 if you are short
steps.speed: Only grind if the quests above did not get you to 12. Loch Modan's first quests are level 10-12.
